cats.name: 语法
cats.desc: 特殊疑问句、名词复数、祈使句、情态动词、名词性物主代词、频度副词、可数与不可数名词、现在进行时、一般过去时……

cats.name: 句型与交际
cats.desc: 谈动物、说规则、谈健身、点餐、打电话、谈天气、谈游学、讲故事等课本重点句型

points.title: 特殊疑问句：问动物
points.explain:
特殊疑问词放句首，后面接一般疑问句语序。
What 什么：What animals do you like?
Why 为什么：Why do you like pandas? — Because they're cute.
Where 哪里：Where are they from? — They're from China.
How 怎样：How do elephants help people?
回答特殊疑问句不用 Yes / No。

examples.en: Why do you like penguins so much?
examples.zh: 你为什么这么喜欢企鹅？

examples.en: Where are they from?
examples.zh: 它们来自哪里？

examples.en: What's your favourite animal?
examples.zh: 你最喜欢的动物是什么？

questions.q:
— ______ do you like koalas?
— Because they're cute.
questions.e: 答语用 Because 说明原因，问句用 Why。
questions.s:
— Why do you like koalas?
— Because they're cute.

questions.q:
— ______ are the giraffes from?
— They're from Africa.
questions.e: 答语说「来自非洲」，问地点用 Where。
questions.s:
— Where are the giraffes from?
— They're from Africa.

questions.q:
— ______ animals do you like?
— I like dolphins.
questions.e: 问「什么动物」用 What + 名词。
questions.s:
— What animals do you like?
— I like dolphins.

questions.q:
— Why don't you like snakes?
— ______ they're scary.
questions.e: 回答 Why 用 Because。
questions.s:
— Why don't you like snakes?
— Because they're scary.

questions.q:
— ______ is your favourite animal?
— The panda.
questions.e: 问「最喜欢的动物是什么」用 What。
questions.s:
— What is your favourite animal?
— The panda.

questions.e: Why + do + 主语 + 动词原形。
questions.s: Why do you like elephants?

points.title: 名词复数：规则与不规则变化
points.explain:
① 一般加 -s：cat → cats，giraffe → giraffes
② 以 s, x, sh, ch 结尾加 -es：fox → foxes，box → boxes
③ 辅音字母 + y 结尾，变 y 为 i 加 -es：butterfly → butterflies
④ 以 f / fe 结尾，多变 f 为 v 加 -es：wolf → wolves，knife → knives
⑤ 不规则：sheep → sheep，fish → fish，deer → deer，mouse → mice，goose → geese，man → men

examples.en: They have large ears and long trunks.
examples.zh: 它们有大耳朵和长鼻子。

examples.en: There are whales, Arctic foxes and many more.
examples.zh: 那里有鲸、北极狐等许多动物。

questions.q: There are three ______ in the forest.
questions.e: 以 x 结尾的名词加 -es：foxes。
questions.s: There are three foxes in the forest.

questions.q: Look! Many ______ are eating grass on the hill.
questions.e: sheep 单复数同形。
questions.s: Look! Many sheep are eating grass on the hill.

questions.q: I can see two ______ in the picture.
questions.e: wolf 变 f 为 v 加 -es：wolves。
questions.s: I can see two wolves in the picture.

questions.q: Some ______ are flying over the flowers.
questions.e: 辅音字母 + y 结尾，变 y 为 i 加 -es。
questions.s: Some butterflies are flying over the flowers.

questions.q: The cat is catching two ______ (mouse).
questions.e: mouse 的复数是不规则的 mice。
questions.s: The cat is catching two mice.

questions.q: There are many ______ (deer) in the forest.
questions.e: deer 单复数同形。
questions.s: There are many deer in the forest.

points.title: 谈论喜欢的动物
points.explain:
问喜好：What's your favourite animal? / What animals do you like?
说理由：I like … because they're cute / smart / friendly / playful.
说不喜欢：I don't like … because they're scary / dangerous.
描述外形：They have long necks / big ears / soft fur.

examples.en: The penguin is my favourite animal.
examples.zh: 企鹅是我最喜欢的动物。

examples.en: They are very playful and love to play in the water.
examples.zh: 它们非常爱玩，喜欢在水里嬉戏。

questions.q:
— Do you like lions?
— ______ They're scary.
questions.e: 后一句说「它们很吓人」，所以不喜欢：No, I don't.
questions.s:
— Do you like lions?
— No, I don't. They're scary.

questions.q: Giraffes have long ______. They can eat leaves from tall trees.
questions.e: 长颈鹿脖子长，能吃到高树上的叶子。
questions.s: Giraffes have long necks. They can eat leaves from tall trees.

questions.q: Dolphins are very ______. They love to play in the water.
questions.e: 「喜欢在水里玩」说明它们爱玩：playful。
questions.s: Dolphins are very playful. They love to play in the water.

questions.q: Elephants are in ______ (危险) because people kill them for their ivory.
questions.e: in danger 处于危险之中。
questions.s: Elephants are in danger because people kill them for their ivory.

questions.a: The panda is my favourite animal.
questions.e: 主语 The panda + is + 表语。
questions.s: The panda is my favourite animal.

points.title: 祈使句：说规则
points.explain:
祈使句用来发出命令、提出要求，一般省略主语 you，动词用原形开头。
肯定：Be quiet. / Arrive on time.
否定：Don't + 动词原形：Don't run in the hallways. / Don't be late.
告示上常用 No + 名词 / doing：No food. / No running.

examples.en: Don't run in the hallway, please.
examples.zh: 请不要在走廊里跑。

examples.en: Be polite and treat one another with respect.
examples.zh: 要有礼貌，互相尊重。

questions.q: ______ late for class again, Tom.
questions.e: late 是形容词，否定祈使句要用 Don't be。
questions.s: Don't be late for class again, Tom.

questions.q: ______ your hands before dinner.
questions.e: 祈使句用动词原形开头。
questions.s: Wash your hands before dinner.

questions.q: Please ______ quiet in the library.
questions.e: 祈使句里 be 动词用原形 be。
questions.s: Please be quiet in the library.

questions.q: The sign says "______". We can't eat here.
questions.e: 告示常用 No + 名词：No food. 禁止饮食。
questions.s: The sign says "No food". We can't eat here.

questions.q: ______ (not run) in the hallways.
questions.e: 否定祈使句：Don't + 动词原形。
questions.s: Don't run in the hallways.

questions.e: 否定祈使句 Don't + 动词原形 + 地点。
questions.s: Don't litter in the park.

points.kp: 情态动词后接动词原形
points.title: can / have to / must 谈规则
points.explain:
can 可以；can't 不可以：We can't eat in class.
must 必须（说话人认为必须）：You must wear a uniform.
mustn't 禁止：You mustn't fight.
have to 不得不（客观要求），主语是三单时用 has to：He has to get up at six.
问句：Do we have to …? — Yes, we do. / No, we don't (have to).
情态动词后面都接动词原形。

examples.en: You have to wear a uniform because it builds school spirit.
examples.zh: 你必须穿校服，因为它能培养集体精神。

examples.en: You mustn't be late for class.
examples.zh: 上课不许迟到。

questions.q: We ______ wear uniforms at school. It's a rule.
questions.e: 主语 We，用 have to 表示规则要求。
questions.s: We have to wear uniforms at school. It's a rule.

questions.q: My sister ______ practise the piano every day.
questions.e: 主语是三单 My sister，用 has to。
questions.s: My sister has to practise the piano every day.

questions.q:
— Must we finish the homework today?
— No, you ______. You can finish it tomorrow.
questions.e: must 问句的否定回答用 needn't 或 don't have to。
questions.s:
— Must we finish the homework today?
— No, you needn't. You can finish it tomorrow.

questions.q: You ______ play football in the classroom. It's dangerous.
questions.e: 「危险」，所以禁止：mustn't。
questions.s: You mustn't play football in the classroom. It's dangerous.

questions.q:
— Do you have to clean your room on weekends?
— Yes, I ______.
questions.e: Do you have to …? 用 do 回答。
questions.s:
— Do you have to clean your room on weekends?
— Yes, I do.

questions.q: Students mustn't ______ (bring) phones to class.
questions.e: 情态动词 mustn't 后接动词原形。
questions.s: Students mustn't bring phones to class.

questions.a: He has to make his bed.
questions.e: 主语三单 + has to + 动词原形。
questions.s: He has to make his bed.

points.title: 抱怨规则与给建议
points.explain:
说规则太多：There are too many rules! / I can't … because I have to …
给建议：You should … / Why don't you …? / Try to …
理解规则：Rules help us to be safe. / Some rules are important.

examples.en: I know some rules are important, but this is awful!
examples.zh: 我知道有些规矩很重要，但这太糟糕了！

examples.en: Can you give these characters any advice?
examples.zh: 你能给这些人物一些建议吗？

questions.q:
— I always forget my homework.
— ______ write a note on your desk?
questions.e: Why don't you + 动词原形？给建议。
questions.s:
— I always forget my homework.
— Why don't you write a note on your desk?

questions.q: There are ______ rules in my family. I can't relax.
questions.e: rules 是可数名词复数，用 too many。
questions.s: There are too many rules in my family. I can't relax.

questions.q: Rules can help us ______ safe.
questions.e: help sb (to) do sth，这里用动词原形 stay。
questions.s: Rules can help us stay safe.

questions.q: Can you give me some ______ (建议) on keeping my room tidy?
questions.e: advice 建议，不可数名词。
questions.s: Can you give me some advice on keeping my room tidy?

questions.a: We can't be late for school.
questions.e: 情态动词 can't + be + late for。
questions.s: We can't be late for school.

points.title: 名词性物主代词
points.explain:
形容词性物主代词后面必须跟名词：my book, his racket
名词性物主代词 = 形容词性物主代词 + 名词，后面不再跟名词：
my → mine，your → yours，his → his，her → hers，its → its，our → ours，their → theirs
Is this your racket? — No, it isn't mine. It's hers.
问「谁的」用 Whose：Whose glove is this?

examples.en: Is this baseball glove yours?
examples.zh: 这个棒球手套是你的吗？

examples.en: My skateboard is really cool, and so are theirs.
examples.zh: 我的滑板很酷，他们的也是。

questions.q:
— Is this your tennis racket?
— No, it isn't ______. It's Ella's.
questions.e: 后面没有名词，用名词性物主代词 mine。
questions.s:
— Is this your tennis racket?
— No, it isn't mine. It's Ella's.

questions.q:
— ______ T-shirt is this?
— It's Tom's.
questions.e: 问「谁的」用 Whose + 名词。
questions.s:
— Whose T-shirt is this?
— It's Tom's.

questions.q: This is not her cap. ______ is blue.
questions.e: 作主语、后面无名词，用 Hers = her cap。
questions.s: This is not her cap. Hers is blue.

questions.q: Our classroom is big, but ______ is bigger.
questions.e: 后面没有名词，用 theirs。
questions.s: Our classroom is big, but theirs is bigger.

questions.q:
— Are these gloves yours?
— Yes, they're ______ (我的).
questions.e: 后面没有名词，用 mine。
questions.s:
— Are these gloves yours?
— Yes, they're mine.

questions.q: The blue bike is ______ (他的), and the red one is mine.
questions.e: his 既是形容词性也是名词性物主代词。
questions.s: The blue bike is his, and the red one is mine.

questions.e: Whose + 名词 + is this?
questions.s: Whose racket is this?

points.title: 频度副词与 How often
points.explain:
always（总是）> usually（通常）> often（经常）> sometimes（有时）> seldom / hardly ever（很少）> never（从不）
位置：放在实义动词前、be 动词和情态动词后：I often play badminton. / She is always happy.
问频率用 How often：How often do you exercise? — Three times a week.
次数：once（一次）、twice（两次）、three times（三次）a week / a month

examples.en: How often do you do sport or exercise?
examples.zh: 你多久做一次运动或锻炼？

examples.en: I play it twice a week, usually at weekends.
examples.zh: 我一周打两次，通常在周末。

questions.q:
— ______ do you play basketball?
— Twice a week.
questions.e: 答语是「一周两次」，问频率用 How often。
questions.s:
— How often do you play basketball?
— Twice a week.

questions.q: I ______ play volleyball. I don't like it at all.
questions.e: 「一点也不喜欢」，所以从不打：never。
questions.s: I never play volleyball. I don't like it at all.

questions.q: Peter ______ late for school. He always gets up early.
questions.e: 频度副词放在 be 动词后；他总早起，所以从不迟到。
questions.s: Peter is never late for school. He always gets up early.

questions.q:
— How often does she go swimming?
— ______.
questions.e: How often 问频率，答 Once a week。
questions.s:
— How often does she go swimming?
— Once a week.

questions.q: I go jogging three ______ (次) a week.
questions.e: 三次及以上用 数字 + times。
questions.s: I go jogging three times a week.

questions.q: My dad ______ (几乎从不) drinks coffee.
questions.e: hardly ever 几乎从不，放在实义动词前。
questions.s: My dad hardly ever drinks coffee.

questions.e: How often + do + 主语 + 动词原形？
questions.s: How often do you exercise?

points.title: 谈保持健康
points.explain:
问方式：How do you keep fit? — I jog / swim / work out every day.
说好处：It keeps me fit. / It makes me feel good. / It builds team spirit.
鼓励：Keep going! / Don't give up! / Practice makes perfect.

examples.en: I like skateboarding because it keeps me fit.
examples.zh: 我喜欢玩滑板，因为它让我保持健康。

examples.en: I'm full of energy after jogging.
examples.zh: 慢跑后我精力充沛。

questions.q:
— How do you keep ______?
— I go swimming every weekend.
questions.e: keep fit 保持健康。
questions.s:
— How do you keep fit?
— I go swimming every weekend.

questions.q: Exercise makes me ______ good.
questions.e: make sb do sth，用动词原形 feel。
questions.s: Exercise makes me feel good.

questions.q:
— I can't do this trick.
— Don't give up! Practice makes ______.
questions.e: Practice makes perfect. 熟能生巧。
questions.s:
— I can't do this trick.
— Don't give up! Practice makes perfect.

questions.q: I'm full of ______ (能量) after playing basketball.
questions.e: be full of energy 精力充沛。
questions.s: I'm full of energy after playing basketball.

questions.e: keep sb + 形容词：让某人保持……
questions.s: Swimming keeps me fit.

points.title: 选择疑问句：or
points.explain:
提供两个或以上的选择，用 or 连接，读的时候 or 前升调、后降调。
Would you like rice or noodles? — Noodles, please.
Which would you like, beef or mutton? — Beef, please.
回答时直接选一个，不用 Yes / No。

examples.en: Would you like juice or coffee?
examples.zh: 你想喝果汁还是咖啡？

examples.en: Which would you like, beef or mutton?
examples.zh: 你想要哪个，牛肉还是羊肉？

questions.q:
— Would you like tea ______ coffee?
— Tea, please.
questions.e: 两者选一，用 or。
questions.s:
— Would you like tea or coffee?
— Tea, please.

questions.q:
— Is your pen red or blue?
— ______
questions.e: 选择疑问句不用 Yes / No 回答，直接说出选项。
questions.s:
— Is your pen red or blue?
— It's blue.

questions.q:
— ______ would you like, rice or dumplings?
— Dumplings, please.
questions.e: 在给定范围里选，用 Which。
questions.s:
— Which would you like, rice or dumplings?
— Dumplings, please.

questions.q: Do you want chicken ______ fish for dinner?
questions.e: 选择疑问句用 or 连接选项。
questions.s: Do you want chicken or fish for dinner?

questions.a: Would you like rice or noodles?
questions.e: Would you like A or B?
questions.s: Would you like rice or noodles?

points.title: 可数与不可数名词（食物）
points.explain:
可数名词有复数：an apple → apples，a carrot → carrots
不可数名词没有复数，不能直接用 a / an：water, milk, juice, rice, bread, meat, beef, tea
表示数量：a glass of milk，two bowls of rice，a piece of bread
问数量：How many + 可数名词复数？How much + 不可数名词？
some 用于肯定句和表示请求的疑问句，any 用于否定句和一般疑问句。

examples.en: But it often has lots of salt, fat, and sugar.
examples.zh: 但它常常含有很多盐、脂肪和糖。

examples.en: Second, I don't drink enough water.
examples.zh: 其次，我喝水不够。

questions.q: I'd like ______ milk, please.
questions.e: milk 不可数，用 some。
questions.s: I'd like some milk, please.

questions.q:
— How ______ water do you drink every day?
— Six glasses.
questions.e: water 不可数，问数量用 How much。
questions.s:
— How much water do you drink every day?
— Six glasses.

questions.q: There are some ______ on the table.
questions.e: tomato 复数加 -es；bread 不可数。
questions.s: There are some tomatoes on the table.

questions.q: Is there ______ juice in the fridge?
questions.e: 一般疑问句用 any。
questions.s: Is there any juice in the fridge?

questions.q: My mum bought three ______ (bottle) of juice.
questions.e: three bottles of juice 三瓶果汁，变的是 bottle。
questions.s: My mum bought three bottles of juice.

questions.q: We need two ______ (potato) for the soup.
questions.e: potato 复数加 -es。
questions.s: We need two potatoes for the soup.

points.title: 点餐用语
points.explain:
服务员：What would you like? / Would you like anything to drink? / Anything else?
顾客：I'd like … / Can I have …? / That's all, thanks. / Can I have the bill, please?
Would you like …? 的回答：Yes, please. / No, thanks.

examples.en: Here is a menu for you.
examples.zh: 给您菜单。

examples.en: Would you like the bill now?
examples.zh: 您现在要结账吗？

questions.q:
— What would you like?
— ______
questions.e: 点餐回答用 I'd like …。
questions.s:
— What would you like?
— I'd like noodles, please.

questions.q:
— Would you like some juice?
— ______ I'm not thirsty.
questions.e: 「不渴」，所以拒绝：No, thanks.
questions.s:
— Would you like some juice?
— No, thanks. I'm not thirsty.

questions.q:
— Anything else?
— ______, thanks.
questions.e: That's all. 就这些。
questions.s:
— Anything else?
— That's all, thanks.

questions.q: Can I have the ______ (账单), please?
questions.e: 结账：Can I have the bill?
questions.s: Can I have the bill, please?

questions.e: What would you like? 您想要什么？
questions.s: What would you like?

points.title: 现在进行时（一）：正在做什么
points.explain:
表示说话时正在进行的动作：am / is / are + 动词-ing。
常和 now, right now, at the moment, Look!, Listen! 连用。
-ing 变化：① 一般加 -ing：read → reading ② 去哑 e 加 -ing：make → making ③ 重读闭音节双写末尾字母：run → running，swim → swimming，shop → shopping
疑问：Are you watching TV? — Yes, I am. / What are you doing?

examples.en: Right now my family and I are visiting friends in Canada.
examples.zh: 现在我和家人正在加拿大拜访朋友。

examples.en: Some people are rushing to get home from work.
examples.zh: 一些人正赶着下班回家。

questions.q: Look! The children ______ in the park.
questions.e: Look! 提示正在进行，children 是复数，用 are playing。
questions.s: Look! The children are playing in the park.

questions.q:
— What ______ your mother doing?
— She is cooking.
questions.e: your mother 是三单，用 is。
questions.s:
— What is your mother doing?
— She is cooking.

questions.q: Listen! Someone ______ at the door.
questions.e: Listen! 提示正在进行，someone 用 is knocking。
questions.s: Listen! Someone is knocking at the door.

questions.q:
— Are you doing your homework?
— ______ I'm reading a book.
questions.e: 后面说在看书，所以否定回答 No, I'm not.
questions.s:
— Are you doing your homework?
— No, I'm not. I'm reading a book.

questions.q: The boys are ______ (swim) in the river now.
questions.e: swim 双写 m 加 -ing。
questions.s: The boys are swimming in the river now.

questions.q: Mum is ______ (make) dumplings in the kitchen.
questions.e: make 去 e 加 -ing。
questions.s: Mum is making dumplings in the kitchen.

questions.e: What + are + 主语 + doing？
questions.s: What are you doing now?

points.title: 打电话用语
points.explain:
开头：Hello, this is … (speaking). / Is that …? / May I speak to …?
对方不在：Sorry, he's out at the moment. / Can I take a message?
留言：Could you ask him to call me back? / Would you like to leave a message?
电话里介绍自己用 This is …，不用 I am …。

examples.en: Can I take a message?
examples.zh: 我可以帮你捎个口信吗？

examples.en: Could you ask him to call me back, please?
examples.zh: 请你让他给我回个电话好吗？

questions.q:
— Hello! ______ Jane speaking.
— Hi, Jane. This is Tom.
questions.e: 打电话介绍自己用 This is …。
questions.s:
— Hello! This is Jane speaking.
— Hi, Jane. This is Tom.

questions.q:
— May I speak to Mr Li?
— Sorry, he's out. ______
questions.e: 对方不在，主动提出帮忙捎口信。
questions.s:
— May I speak to Mr Li?
— Sorry, he's out. Can I take a message?

questions.q: Could you ask her to ______ me back?
questions.e: ask sb to do sth，to 后接动词原形 call。
questions.s: Could you ask her to call me back?

questions.q: Would you like to ______ (留) a message?
questions.e: leave a message 留个口信。
questions.s: Would you like to leave a message?

questions.e: 电话用语：This is … speaking.
questions.s: This is Mary speaking.

points.title: 现在进行时（二）：描述天气与活动
points.explain:
描述此刻的天气和人们在做的事：It's raining. / The sun is shining. / Many people are skating.
问天气：How's the weather? = What's the weather like? — It's sunny / cloudy / windy / snowing.
天气形容词：rain → rainy，snow → snowy，sun → sunny，wind → windy，cloud → cloudy，storm → stormy

examples.en: It's raining and the wind is blowing hard.
examples.zh: 在下雨，风刮得很猛。

examples.en: Look, the sun is shining!
examples.zh: 看，太阳出来了！

questions.q:
— How's the weather in Beijing?
— It's ______.
questions.e: 描述天气用形容词：snowy。
questions.s:
— How's the weather in Beijing?
— It's snowy.

questions.q:
— ______ the weather like today?
— It's cloudy.
questions.e: What's the weather like? = How's the weather?
questions.s:
— What's the weather like today?
— It's cloudy.

questions.q: It's ______ hard now. Take an umbrella.
questions.e: It's raining. 正在下雨，用现在进行时。
questions.s: It's raining hard now. Take an umbrella.

questions.q: Many people ______ on the ice right now.
questions.e: right now 表示正在进行，主语复数用 are skating。
questions.s: Many people are skating on the ice right now.

questions.q: It's very ______ (wind) today. Let's fly a kite.
questions.e: wind 加 -y 变形容词 windy。
questions.s: It's very windy today. Let's fly a kite.

questions.q: Look! The sun ______ (shine) brightly.
questions.e: Look! 提示正在进行：is shining。
questions.s: Look! The sun is shining brightly.

questions.e: 问天气：What's the weather like?
questions.s: What's the weather like?

points.title: 谈天气对心情和活动的影响
points.explain:
天气影响心情：Sunny days make me happy. / I feel down on rainy days.
提建议：It's a good day for … / Let's … because it's sunny.
回应：Sounds great! / Lucky you!

examples.en: I'm always happy, rain or shine!
examples.zh: 无论晴雨，我总是很开心！

examples.en: Well, it affects where we go, what we do, and what we wear.
examples.zh: 嗯，它影响我们去哪里、做什么、穿什么。

questions.q:
— It's sunny and warm here.
— ______! It's raining here.
questions.e: 对方那里天气好，表示羡慕：Lucky you!
questions.s:
— It's sunny and warm here.
— Lucky you! It's raining here.

questions.q: Rainy weather sometimes makes people ______ sad.
questions.e: make sb do sth。
questions.s: Rainy weather sometimes makes people feel sad.

questions.q: The weather ______ what we wear.
questions.e: 主语 The weather 是三单，用 affects。
questions.s: The weather affects what we wear.

questions.q: We play football every Saturday, rain or ______ (晴).
questions.e: rain or shine 无论晴雨。
questions.s: We play football every Saturday, rain or shine.

questions.a: It's a good day for swimming.
questions.e: It's a good day for + 名词/动名词。
questions.s: It's a good day for swimming.

points.title: 一般过去时（一）：be 动词与规则动词
points.explain:
表示过去发生的事，常和 yesterday, last week, ago, this morning 连用。
be 动词：am / is → was，are → were：It was a great day.
规则动词加 -ed：visit → visited，live → lived，study → studied，stop → stopped
否定和疑问借助 did，动词还原：I didn't visit the museum. / Did you go on a school trip? — Yes, I did.
问经历：How was your trip? — It was amazing!

examples.en: How was your school trip to the wastewater plant?
examples.zh: 你们学校去污水处理厂的游学怎么样？

examples.en: Finally, we watered the plants.
examples.zh: 最后，我们给植物浇了水。

questions.q:
— How ______ your weekend?
— It was great.
questions.e: 问过去的周末，主语 your weekend 用 was。
questions.s:
— How was your weekend?
— It was great.

questions.q: We ______ a farm last Sunday.
questions.e: last Sunday 是过去时间，用 visited。
questions.s: We visited a farm last Sunday.

questions.q:
— Did you go to the museum yesterday?
— Yes, I ______.
questions.e: Did you …? 用 did 回答。
questions.s:
— Did you go to the museum yesterday?
— Yes, I did.

questions.q: They ______ at home last night.
questions.e: 主语 They，过去时用 were。
questions.s: They were at home last night.

questions.q: She ______ (study) for the exam yesterday.
questions.e: 辅音字母 + y，变 y 为 i 加 -ed。
questions.s: She studied for the exam yesterday.

questions.q: The bus ______ (stop) at the farm gate.
questions.e: 重读闭音节双写 p 加 -ed。
questions.s: The bus stopped at the farm gate.

questions.e: 否定：didn't + 动词原形。
questions.s: I didn't visit the museum.

points.title: 谈论学校游学
points.explain:
问经历：How was your school trip? / What did you do there? / Did you learn anything?
回答：It was amazing / tiring / interesting. / We learnt how to … / I enjoyed working with my hands.

examples.en: It was tiring but great fun!
examples.zh: 很累，但非常有趣！

examples.en: I didn't realize it was so hard.
examples.zh: 我没意识到这么难。

questions.q:
— How was your school trip?
— ______
questions.e: How was …? 问感受，回答 It was amazing!
questions.s:
— How was your school trip?
— It was amazing!

questions.q: We learnt ______ to plant tomatoes.
questions.e: learn how to do 学习怎样做。
questions.s: We learnt how to plant tomatoes.

questions.q: I enjoyed ______ with my hands.
questions.e: enjoy doing sth。
questions.s: I enjoyed working with my hands.

questions.q: It was tiring, ______ (但是) I had a lot of fun.
questions.e: 表示转折用 but。
questions.s: It was tiring, but I had a lot of fun.

questions.e: What did + 主语 + 动词原形？
questions.s: What did you do there?

points.title: 一般过去时（二）：不规则动词与讲故事
points.explain:
讲故事多用一般过去时。常见不规则动词：
go → went，come → came，see → saw，say → said，tell → told，think → thought，find → found，make → made，take → took，give → gave，bite → bit，catch → caught，fly → flew，become → became，begin → began，leave → left
讲故事的顺序词：Once upon a time / One day / Then / Later / Finally / In the end

examples.en: Once upon a time, an emperor liked clothes very much.
examples.zh: 从前，有个皇帝非常喜欢衣服。

examples.en: Later, a hunter caught the lion in a net.
examples.zh: 后来，一个猎人用网抓住了狮子。

questions.q: One day, the duckling ______ a cat and a hen.
questions.e: 讲过去的故事，meet 的过去式是 met。
questions.s: One day, the duckling met a cat and a hen.

questions.q: The mouse ______ through the net and set the lion free.
questions.e: bite 的过去式是 bit。
questions.s: The mouse bit through the net and set the lion free.

questions.q: He ______ the truth to everyone.
questions.e: tell 的过去式是 told。
questions.s: He told the truth to everyone.

questions.q:
— Did the farmer find his horse?
— Yes, he ______.
questions.e: Did …? 用 did 回答。
questions.s:
— Did the farmer find his horse?
— Yes, he did.

questions.q: Once upon a time, a fisherman ______ (catch) a bottle in his net.
questions.e: catch 的过去式是 caught。
questions.s: Once upon a time, a fisherman caught a bottle in his net.

questions.q: The ugly duckling ______ (become) a beautiful swan.
questions.e: become 的过去式是 became。
questions.s: The ugly duckling became a beautiful swan.

questions.a: The lion let the mouse go.
questions.e: let sb do sth，let 的过去式还是 let。
questions.s: The lion let the mouse go.

points.title: 复述故事与表达看法
points.explain:
讲故事：What happened next? / In the end, … / The story tells us that …
说看法：I think the story is … / I learnt that we should …
常用寓意：Don't judge a book by its cover. / Tell the truth.

examples.en: Why do you think everyone started laughing at the end?
examples.zh: 你认为最后大家为什么都笑了？

examples.en: I can express my thoughts and feelings about a story.
examples.zh: 我能表达我对一个故事的想法和感受。

questions.q:
— What ______ next?
— The lion let the mouse go.
questions.e: 讲过去的故事，问「接下来发生了什么」用 happened。
questions.s:
— What happened next?
— The lion let the mouse go.

questions.q: The story tells us ______ we should tell the truth.
questions.e: tell sb that + 句子。
questions.s: The story tells us that we should tell the truth.

questions.q: ______ the end, the ugly duckling became a swan.
questions.e: in the end 最后。
questions.s: In the end, the ugly duckling became a swan.

questions.q: They ______ (pretend) to make clothes for the emperor.
questions.e: pretend 规则变化加 -ed。
questions.s: They pretended to make clothes for the emperor.

questions.e: laugh at sb 嘲笑某人。
questions.s: Everyone laughed at the emperor.
